newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Nizhny Novgorod to register Eurobond soon.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Nizhny Novgorod to register Eurobond soon.

text.p: Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region plans to register its Eurobond with the Finance Ministry at the end of May or start of June, an official at the Regional Agency for Aide to Investment said on Tuesday.
"We are preparing documents for registration," deputy chief executive Andrei Zotikov told Reuters. "After our Legislative Council convenes we shall send the documents off."
Nizhny Novgorod plans to issue up to $100 million in five-year Eurobonds in late June and Zotikov said the region had not changed the timing of the issue.
